card.name: Inside ALL-CAPS technical headings
card.fires_on: Words and word parts inside ALL-CAPS text, such as headings and shouted sentences in science and engineering passages. It often sits on a small word like OF, ARE or a dash between capitalised terms.

modes.label: Caps title words
modes.description: Small linking words or word parts inside an all-caps title or agency name.

modes.label: Dash between caps headings
modes.description: A dash that ends a sentence and leads into the next capitalised technique heading.

modes.label: Caps science statements
modes.description: Parts of chemical or physics terms and numbers in all-caps sentences.

card.writes: It lowers the chance of element names like oxygen, nitrogen, carbon and hydrogen, and slightly raises capitalised name starts like Black, Las and Car.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of shouted all-caps science and engineering text, where the next word is unlikely to be a plain element name.
